description.en:
Leaves a one-shot request for one in-match menu, named by its ID. The engine only ever checks it for "KsnBtlMenu", the menu used in a Fighting Spirit clash (ksn = keshin). When that menu queries the request it gets true, and the request is cleared at once.
The name says it disables the menu's way back (return option); the exact effect on screen was not traced.
The only shipped use is in btl0002.nut, at the moment a Fighting Spirit appears, just before the scene that introduces the clash.
Menu ID. Only "KsnBtlMenu" is recognised; any other name is stored but never matched.

examples.case: When a Fighting Spirit appears in a story match (real usage, from btl0002.nut)
